/-- The rectangle a road user's body covers on the ground, from its position, heading and
    half-extents; `none` when one of them is not observed. -/
def footprint (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option (List Vec) := do
  let p ← kin_position s x
  let h ← kin_heading s x
  let (hl, hw, _) ← kin_extent s x
  let u ← Geom.unit h
  let v := (Q.neg u.2, u.1)
  let corner (a b : Q) : Vec := Geom.vadd p (Q.add (Q.mul a u.1) (Q.mul b v.1), Q.add (Q.mul a u.2) (Q.mul b v.2))
  pure [corner hl hw, corner hl (Q.neg hw), corner (Q.neg hl) (Q.neg hw), corner (Q.neg hl) hw]

/-- Ground distance from a road user's body to a region: zero when the footprint overlaps the
    boundary, otherwise the nearest approach between the two outlines. Without a footprint (no
    extent or heading observed) the reference point is used; a point-like structure is measured
    to its reference point. -/
def st_region_geometry_distance (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) (r : RegionId) : Option Q := do
  let p ← kin_position s x
  match st_region_geometry_boundary s r, footprint s x with
  | some poly, some fp =>
    if Geom.polygonsOverlap fp poly then some Q.zero
    else
      let ds := fp.filterMap (Geom.polygonDistance · poly) ++ poly.filterMap (Geom.polygonDistance · fp)
      ds.foldl (fun acc d => match acc with | none => some d | some a => some (Q.min a d)) none
  | some poly, none => Geom.polygonDistance p poly
  | none, fp =>
    let c ← st_region_geometry_position s r
    match fp with
    | some poly => Geom.polygonDistance c poly
    | none => some (Geom.norm (Geom.vsub c p))
/-- The regions present in the scene known to be of a kind (`Structure.isOfKind` true). -/
def regionsOfKind (s : Scene) (k : StructureKind) : List RegionId :=
  (s.structures.filter (·.isOfKind k == some true)).map (·.id)
/-- The regions a quantifier over a kind ranges over: those whose membership of the kind is not
    false (`Structure.isOfKind`), the known members and those that may be members. -/
def regionCandidates (s : Scene) (k : StructureKind) : List RegionId :=
  (s.structures.filter (·.isOfKind k != some false)).map (·.id)

def rel_occupies (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) (r : RegionId) : Option Bool :=

/-- Whether a device is of a kind: unknown where the source cannot tell that kind. -/
def devKind (s : Scene) (d : DeviceId) (k : DeviceKind) : Option Bool :=
  (s.device d).bind fun dv => if dv.unobservedKinds.contains k then none else some (dv.kind == k)

def dev_traffic_signal (s : Scene) (d : DeviceId) : Option Bool := devKind s d .trafficSignal
def dev_traffic_signal_indications (s : Scene) (d : DeviceId) : Option (List SignalIndication) := (s.device d).bind (·.indications)

def dev_pedestrian_signal_state (s : Scene) (d : DeviceId) : Option PedSignalState := (s.device d).bind (·.pedState)
def dev_pedestrian_signal_countdown (s : Scene) (d : DeviceId) : Option Bool := (s.device d).bind (·.countdown)
def dev_lane_control_signal (s : Scene) (d : DeviceId) : Option Bool := devKind s d .laneControlSignal
def dev_lane_control_signal_state (s : Scene) (d : DeviceId) : Option LaneControlState := (s.device d).bind (·.laneControl)
def dev_speed_limit_beacon (s : Scene) (d : DeviceId) : Option Bool := devKind s d .speedLimitBeacon
def dev_speed_limit_beacon_flashing (s : Scene) (d : DeviceId) : Option Bool := (s.device d).bind (·.flashing)
def dev_crossing_warning_signal (s : Scene) (d : DeviceId) : Option Bool := devKind s d .crossingWarningSignal
def dev_crossing_warning_signal_active (s : Scene) (d : DeviceId) : Option Bool := (s.device d).bind (·.active)
def dev_stop_sign (s : Scene) (d : DeviceId) : Option Bool := devKind s d .stopSign
def dev_yield_sign (s : Scene) (d : DeviceId) : Option Bool := devKind s d .yieldSign
def dev_speed_limit_sign (s : Scene) (d : DeviceId) : Option Bool := devKind s d .speedLimitSign
def dev_speed_limit_sign_value (s : Scene) (d : DeviceId) : Option Q := (s.device d).bind (·.speedValue)
def dev_speed_limit_sign_kind (s : Scene) (d : DeviceId) : Option SpeedSignKind := (s.device d).bind (·.speedKind)
def dev_regulatory_sign (s : Scene) (d : DeviceId) : Option Bool := devKind s d .regulatorySign
def dev_regulatory_sign_code (s : Scene) (d : DeviceId) : Option SignCode := (s.device d).bind (·.code)
def dev_regulatory_sign_conditions (s : Scene) (d : DeviceId) : Option Conditions := (s.device d).bind (·.conditions)
def dev_zone_sign (s : Scene) (d : DeviceId) : Option Bool := devKind s d .zoneSign
def dev_zone_sign_kind (s : Scene) (d : DeviceId) : Option ZoneKind := (s.device d).bind (·.zoneKind)
def dev_zone_sign_end (s : Scene) (d : DeviceId) : Option Bool := (s.device d).bind (·.isEnd)
def dev_zone_sign_conditions (s : Scene) (d : DeviceId) : Option Conditions := (s.device d).bind (·.conditions)
def dev_railway_signal_or_gate (s : Scene) (d : DeviceId) : Option Bool := devKind s d .railwaySignalOrGate
def dev_railway_signal_or_gate_lights (s : Scene) (d : DeviceId) : Option RailLights := (s.device d).bind (·.railLights)
def dev_railway_signal_or_gate_gate (s : Scene) (d : DeviceId) : Option GateState := (s.device d).bind (·.gate)

def dev_human_direction_role (s : Scene) (d : DeviceId) : Option HumanRole := (s.device d).bind (·.humanRole)

  (s.device d).bind fun dv => if dv.governsObserved then some (dv.governs.contains r) else none

  (s.device d).bind fun dv => if dv.governsObserved then some dv.governs else none

/-- The devices of a kind present in the scene. -/
def devicesOfKind (s : Scene) (k : DeviceKind) : List DeviceId :=
  (s.devices.filter (·.kind == k)).map (·.id)
/-- The devices a quantifier over a kind ranges over: those of the kind, and those whose kind the
    source cannot tell, which may be of it. -/
def deviceCandidates (s : Scene) (k : DeviceKind) : List DeviceId :=

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Signals emitted by road users
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def sig_turn_indicator (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option TurnIndicatorState := (s.user x).bind (·.sig.turnIndicator)

  (sig_warning_lamp s x).map (·.any fun l => l.colour == c && l.mode == m)

-- Environment
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

def env_visibility (s : Scene) : Option Q := s.env.visibility

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Relations between road users. Measured where the source supplies them, otherwise computed
-- from kinematics. `none` when a needed kinematic is missing.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def rel_centre_distance (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Q :=
  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.centreDistance) with
  | some d => some d
  | none => do
    let pa ← kin_position s a
    let pb ← kin_position s b
    pure (Geom.norm (Geom.vsub pb pa))

/-- Components of `b`'s position relative to `a` in `a`'s heading frame (longitudinal, lateral). -/
private def relFrame (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option (Q × Q) := do
  let pa ← kin_position s a
  let pb ← kin_position s b
  let ha ← kin_heading s a
  Geom.inFrame ha (Geom.vsub pb pa)

/-- The gap between the two bodies: the vector from the nearest point of `a`'s footprint to the
    nearest point of `b`'s, each footprint read with its own heading and extent, given as its
    lengths along and across `a`'s heading (longitudinal, lateral). Neither is ever negative; both
    are zero exactly when the footprints touch or overlap. `none` when either footprint is not
    observed, and when a supplied gap has a negative component. -/
def rel_surface_gap (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option (Q × Q) :=
  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.surfaceGap) with
  | some g => if Q.isNonneg g.1 && Q.isNonneg g.2 then some g else none
  | none => do
    let fa ← footprint s a
    let fb ← footprint s b
    let d ← Geom.nearestOffset fa fb
    let ha ← kin_heading s a
    let (lon, lat) ← Geom.inFrame ha d
    pure (Q.abs lon, Q.abs lat)
def rel_surface_gap_longitudinal (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Q := (rel_surface_gap s a b).map (·.1)
def rel_surface_gap_lateral (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Q := (rel_surface_gap s a b).map (·.2)
/-- The distance between the nearest points of the two bodies, the gap's length: zero on contact
    or overlap, never negative. -/
def rel_surface_gap_distance (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Q := (rel_surface_gap s a b).map Geom.norm

/-- `a` and `b` share a lane and `a` is ahead of `b` along `a`'s heading. The lane is any region both
    occupy that is of kind lane (`Structure.isOfKind`): unknown when `a` is ahead and no shared region
    is known to be a lane but one may be. -/
def rel_ahead_behind_in_lane (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool :=
  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.aAheadOfB) with
  | some v => some v
  | none => do
    let ra ← rel_occupies_regions s a
    let rb ← rel_occupies_regions s b
    let (lon, _) ← relFrame s a b
    if !Q.lt lon Q.zero then some false
    else
      let shared := (s.structures.filter fun st => ra.contains st.id && rb.contains st.id).map (·.isOfKind .lane)
      if shared.contains (some true) then some true
      else if shared.contains none then none
      else some false
def rel_ahead_in_lane (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := rel_ahead_behind_in_lane s a b
def rel_behind_in_lane (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := rel_ahead_behind_in_lane s b a

/-- Signed overlap of the two footprints along `a`'s heading, each read with its own heading and
    extent: the length their projections on that axis share, positive when the bodies are side by
    side, otherwise the gap between the projections negated. A projection: it reads nothing across
    the axis, so a positive value is no contact and a negative one no distance between the bodies. -/
def rel_longitudinal_overlap (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Q :=
  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.longitudinalOverlap) with
  | some v => some v
  | none => do
    let pa ← kin_position s a
    let ha ← kin_heading s a
    let u ← Geom.unit ha
    let fa ← footprint s a
    let fb ← footprint s b
    let (loA, hiA) ← Geom.span u pa fa
    let (loB, hiB) ← Geom.span u pa fb
    pure (Q.sub (Q.min hiA hiB) (Q.max loA loB))

/-- Headings opposed (cosine below `-cosTol`) and the distance decreasing. -/
def rel_oncoming (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) (cosTol : Q) : Option Bool :=
  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.oncoming) with
  | some v => some v
  | none => do
    let ha ← kin_heading s a
    let hb ← kin_heading s b
    let pa ← kin_position s a
    let pb ← kin_position s b
    let va ← kin_velocity s a
    let vb ← kin_velocity s b
    let ua ← Geom.unit ha
    let ub ← Geom.unit hb
    let closing := Q.lt (Geom.dot (Geom.vsub pb pa) (Geom.vsub vb va)) Q.zero
    pure (Q.lt (Geom.dot ua ub) (Q.neg cosTol) && closing)

/-- Headings aligned (cosine above `cosTol`). -/
def rel_same_direction (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) (cosTol : Q) : Option Bool :=
  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.sameDirection) with
  | some v => some v
  | none => do
    let ha ← kin_heading s a
    let hb ← kin_heading s b
    let ua ← Geom.unit ha
    let ub ← Geom.unit hb
    pure (Q.gt (Geom.dot ua ub) cosTol)

/-- `b` relative to `a` in `a`'s frame: (longitudinal, lateral), lateral positive to the left. -/
def rel_bearing (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Vec :=
  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.bearing) with
  | some v => some v
  | none => relFrame s a b
def rel_bearing_right (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := (rel_bearing s a b).map fun v => Q.lt v.2 Q.zero
def rel_bearing_left (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := (rel_bearing s a b).map fun v => Q.gt v.2 Q.zero
def rel_bearing_ahead (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := (rel_bearing s a b).map fun v => Q.gt v.1 Q.zero
def rel_bearing_behind (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := (rel_bearing s a b).map fun v => Q.lt v.1 Q.zero

/-- The bodies touch or overlap. -/
def rel_contact (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool :=
  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.contact) with
  | some v => some v
  | none => (rel_surface_gap s a b).map fun g => Q.le g.1 Q.zero && Q.le g.2 Q.zero

/-- `b` is in `a`'s line of sight, as the source tested it; never computed. -/
def rel_visible (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := (s.relation a b).bind (·.visible)

end TrafficSpec

import TrafficSpec.Core.Language.Rule

namespace TrafficSpec.Rules.LVMC_11_18_020

/-- The binders, as arguments (order and names are the node's). -/
def vSubject : Arg := .var "subject"

def zeroMetres : Term := .lit Q.zero .metre

def vC : Arg := .var "c"
def vJ : Arg := .var "j"
def vD : Arg := .var "d"
def vCw : Arg := .var "cw"
def vO : Arg := .var "o"
def vW : Arg := .var "w"
def vCl : Arg := .var "cl"
def vR : Arg := .var "r"

/-- `x`'s footprint overlaps region `r` (rel.occupies). -/
def occ (x r : Arg) : Formula := .atom "rel_occupies" [x, r] []

/-- Class of `subject`: ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle -/
def clsSubject : Formula := .atom "ru_aggregate" [vSubject, .lit "DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle"] []

/-- k8: a person on foot or in a wheelchair, or riding a bicycle, an electric bicycle or an electric
    scooter. -/
def personClass : Formula :=
  .or (.or (.atom "ru_pedestrian" [vO] []) (.atom "ru_bicycle" [vO] []))
      (.or (.atom "ru_electric_bicycle" [vO] []) (.atom "ru_electric_scooter" [vO] []))

/-- L: the signed lateral offset of the centre line from the subject (left positive). -/
def lateralOfCentreLine : Term := .quantity "prim_region_lateral_offset" [vSubject, vCl] []

/-- y: the lateral component of o's bearing from the subject (left positive). -/
def lateralOfPerson : Term := .measure "rel_bearing" [vSubject, vO, .lit "y"]

/-- k7: o is on the side of the roadway on which the subject is coming. -/
def onSubjectSide : Formula :=
  .or
    (.existsRegion (.lit "highway") "w"
      (.and (.atom "st_on_way" [vCw, vW] [])
        (.existsRegion (.lit "centre_line") "cl"
          (.and (.atom "st_on_way" [vCl, vW] [])
            (.or
              (.and (.cmp lateralOfCentreLine .gt zeroMetres) (.cmp lateralOfPerson .lt lateralOfCentreLine))
              (.and (.cmp lateralOfCentreLine .lt zeroMetres) (.cmp lateralOfPerson .gt lateralOfCentreLine)))))))
    (.existsRegion (.lit "one_way_roadway") "r" (occ vSubject vR))

/-- k6, k8, k9, k7: some person other than the subject in cw, on the subject's side. -/
def personInCrosswalk : Formula :=
  .existsUser "o"
    (.and (.not (.same vO vSubject))
      (.and personClass
        (.and (occ vO vCw) onSubjectSide)))

/-- k5 with k6–k9, for bound c, j, d, cw: the subject occupies carrier c entering intersection j, a
    School-Xing zone sign d governs c, crosswalk cw marks c's entrance, and a person of the named
    classes is in cw on the subject's side. -/
def selection : Formula :=
  .and (occ vSubject vC)
    (.and (.atom "st_lane_enters" [vC, vJ] [])
      (.and (.atom "dev_zone_sign_kind" [vD, .lit "school_crossing"] [])
        (.and (.atom "dev_governs" [vD, vC] [])
          (.and (.atom "st_entrance_of" [vCw, vC] [])
            personInCrosswalk))))

/-- Applicability: k1 (condition): The City Traffic Engineer is authorized to mark and maintain with yellow paint or road buttons crosswalks approximately twelve feet in width at intersections in the vicinity of schools where in the opinion of the City Traffic Engineer crossing the roadway by schoolchildren is unsafe.; k2 (condition): The City Traffic Engineer, if necessary, is further authorized to mark and maintain with a distinguishing color or road buttons upon the pavement or by signs erected along the curb in a conspicuous manner, the words "School-Xing," not less than one hundred feet in advance of each crosswalk established; k5 (condition): where there is displayed a sign with the words "School-Xing,"; k6 (condition): when there is in the crosswalk; k7 (condition): upon the side of the roadway on which said vehicle is coming; k8 (condition): any person; k9 (condition): attempting to cross the street -/
def applicability : Formula :=
  .existsRegion (.lit "travel_region") "c"
    (.existsRegion (.lit "intersection") "j"
      (.existsDevice (.lit "zone_sign") "d"
        (.existsRegion (.lit "crosswalk") "cw" selection)))

  .forallRegion (.lit "travel_region") "c"
    (.forallRegion (.lit "intersection") "j"
      (.forallDevice (.lit "zone_sign") "d"
        (.forallRegion (.lit "crosswalk") "cw"
          (.implies selection (.not (.rises (occ vSubject vCw)))))))

  { id := "LVMC_11_18_020"
    laws := ["LVMC-11-18-020"]
    binders :=
      [ { name := "subject", cls := clsSubject } ]
    applicability := applicability
    obligation := obligation
    assumptions := []

1	/-
2	  TrafficSpec.Core.Evidence.Builders
3	  Scenarios for witnesses and tests: a scene and a trace from a few named quantities, padding by
4	  timestamp, masking under a manifest, and the `Scenario` a witness file declares.
5	
6	  A witness must be indistinguishable from adapter output to an atom, so everything here goes
7	  through the `World` constructors and nothing else. Reachable from `Witness/**` and `Tests/**`
8	  only: a rule that could build its own evidence proves nothing.
9	
10	  No default magnitude lives here — every extent, speed and distance is an argument the witness
11	  writes through a `Units` constructor.
12	-/
13	import TrafficSpec.Core.Runtime.Monitor
14	
15	namespace TrafficSpec
16	namespace Build
17	
18	/-- Cardinal unit headings in the world frame (+x east, +y north). -/
19	def east : Vec := (Q.ofInt 1, Q.zero)
20	def west : Vec := (Q.ofInt (-1), Q.zero)
21	def north : Vec := (Q.zero, Q.ofInt 1)
22	def south : Vec := (Q.zero, Q.ofInt (-1))
23	
24	def scale (h : Vec) (k : Q) : Vec := (Q.mul h.1 k, Q.mul h.2 k)
25	
26	/-- A road user with position, heading and speed; velocity follows the heading, path length
27	    is the caller's (cumulative) figure, extents are half-length/half-width/half-height. -/
28	def user (track : TrackId) (classes : List RoadUserClass) (pos : Vec) (heading : Vec) (speed : Q)
29	    (halfExtent : Q × Q × Q) (pathLength : Option Q := none) : RoadUser :=
30	  { track := track
31	    classes := some classes
32	    kin := { position := some pos
33	             heading := some heading
34	             velocity := some (scale heading speed)
35	             speed := some speed
36	             extent := some halfExtent
37	             pathLength := pathLength } }
38	
39	/-- A road user of which only the position (and classes) was observed. -/
40	def sparseUser (track : TrackId) (classes : List RoadUserClass) (pos : Vec) : RoadUser :=
41	  { track := track, classes := some classes, kin := { position := some pos } }
42	
43	def withSignals (u : RoadUser) (f : Signals → Signals) : RoadUser := { u with sig := f u.sig }
44	def withKin (u : RoadUser) (f : Kin → Kin) : RoadUser := { u with kin := f u.kin }
45	/-- A measured relation from `a` to `b`, with the measured fields the source supplies. -/
46	def relation (a b : TrackId) (f : MeasuredRelation → MeasuredRelation := id) : MeasuredRelation := f { a := a, b := b }
47	def withRelations (s : Scene) (rs : List MeasuredRelation) : Scene := { s with relations := rs }
48	
49	/-- A region of a kind with a polygon boundary. -/
50	def region (id : RegionId) (kind : StructureKind) (boundary : List Vec) : Structure :=
51	  { id := id, kind := kind, boundary := some boundary }
52	/-- An axis-aligned rectangular region from two corners. -/
53	def rect (id : RegionId) (kind : StructureKind) (x0 y0 x1 y1 : Q) : Structure :=
54	  region id kind [(x0, y0), (x1, y0), (x1, y1), (x0, y1)]
55	/-- A lane with its direction and neighbours. -/
56	def lane (id : RegionId) (boundary : List Vec) (direction : Vec)
57	    (left right : Option RegionId := none) (ordinal count : Option Nat := none)
58	    (leadsTo : Option (List RegionId) := none) (enters : Option RegionId := none) : Structure :=
59	  { id := id
60	    kind := .lane
61	    boundary := some boundary
62	    lane := some { direction := some direction, leftNeighbour := left, rightNeighbour := right,
63	                   ordinalFromLeft := ordinal, countInDirection := count, leadsTo := leadsTo,
64	                   entersIntersection := enters } }
65	def point (id : RegionId) (kind : StructureKind) (pos : Vec) : Structure :=
66	  { id := id, kind := kind, position := some pos }
67	
68	def device (id : DeviceId) (kind : DeviceKind) (governs : List RegionId) (pos : Option Vec := none) : Device :=
69	  { id := id, kind := kind, governs := governs, position := pos }
70	def signal (id : DeviceId) (governs : List RegionId) (shows : List SignalIndication) : Device :=
71	  { device id .trafficSignal governs with indications := some shows }
72	def sign (id : DeviceId) (kind : DeviceKind) (governs : List RegionId) : Device := device id kind governs
73	def speedLimit (id : DeviceId) (governs : List RegionId) (value : Q) (kind : SpeedSignKind) : Device :=
74	  { device id .speedLimitSign governs with speedValue := some value, speedKind := some kind }
75	def zoneSign (id : DeviceId) (governs : List RegionId) (kind : ZoneKind) (isEnd : Bool)
76	    (conditions : Option Conditions := none) : Device :=
77	  { device id .zoneSign governs with zoneKind := some kind, isEnd := some isEnd, conditions := conditions }
78	
79	/-- Occupancy from the geometry: every user inside every region whose boundary contains its position. -/
80	def occupancyFromGeometry (users : List RoadUser) (structures : List Structure) : List (TrackId × RegionId) :=
81	  users.flatMap fun u =>
82	    match u.kin.position with
83	    | none => []
84	    | some p => structures.filterMap fun st =>
85	      match st.boundary with
86	      | some poly => if Geom.inPolygon p poly then some (u.track, st.id) else none
87	      | none => none
88	
89	/-- A scene; occupancy is derived from geometry unless given. -/
90	def scene (t : Timestamp) (subject : Option TrackId) (users : List RoadUser) (structures : List Structure)
91	    (devices : List Device) (occupies : Option (List (TrackId × RegionId)) := none)
92	    (env : Env := {}) (assumptions : List (AsmId × Bool) := []) (intents : List DeclaredIntent := []) : Scene :=
93	  { t := t
94	    subject := subject
95	    users := users
96	    structures := structures
97	    devices := devices
98	    occupancyObserved := users.map (·.track)
99	    occupies := occupies.getD (occupancyFromGeometry users structures)
100	    env := env
101	    assumptions := assumptions
102	    intents := intents }
103	
104	/-- A trace from a scene generator over instants `t0, t0 + dt, …` (`dt` in seconds). -/
105	def trace (n : Nat) (t0 : Timestamp) (dt : Q) (f : Nat → Timestamp → Scene) : Trace :=
106	  (List.range n).map fun k =>
107	    let t : Timestamp := t0 + (Q.mul (Q.ofInt (Int.ofNat k)) (Q.mul dt (Q.ofInt 1000))).num /
108	      (Q.mul dt (Q.ofInt 1000)).den
109	    f k t
110	
111	/-- Repeat the first and last scenes for `before`/`after` seconds at spacing `dt`, so that windows
112	    at the ends of the interesting part are covered rather than truncated. -/
113	def pad (τ : Trace) (before after dt : Q) : Trace :=
114	  match τ.head?, τ.getLast? with
115	  | some first, some last =>
116	    let step : Timestamp := (Q.mul dt (Q.ofInt 1000)).num / (Q.mul dt (Q.ofInt 1000)).den
117	    let nb := ((Q.div before dt).num / (Q.div before dt).den).toNat
118	    let na := ((Q.div after dt).num / (Q.div after dt).den).toNat
119	    let pre := (List.range nb).reverse.map fun k => { first with t := first.t - step * (k + 1) }
120	    let post := (List.range na).map fun k => { last with t := last.t + step * (k + 1) }
121	    pre ++ τ ++ post
122	  | _, _ => τ
123	
124	def masked (m : Manifest) (τ : Trace) : Trace := maskTrace m τ
125	
126	/-- A manifest that observes every atom except the listed ids (for a `blind` witness). -/
127	def manifest (absent : List String := []) (gap : Q := Q.zero) : Manifest :=
128	  let full := Manifest.full "witness" gap
129	  { full with entries := full.entries.map fun (id, c) => if absent.contains id then (id, .absent) else (id, c) }
130	
131	end Build
132	
133	/-- A witness: a rule, a trace, the reading and manifest it assumes, the grounding it speaks
134	    about (binder ↦ track) and the episode verdict the plan declared over `window` (a closed range
135	    of timestamps; the whole trace when absent). A lookback window is truncated at the start of
136	    every finite trace, so a witness about a rule with one names the instants it speaks about.
137	    A witness is a test of the rule, not evidence about the law: it shows the formulas reach the
138	    verdict it names, on a scene its author built. A history-boundary witness (`boundary` names the
139	    history its trace lacks) shows that the rule stays unknown where the trace does not reach back
140	    far enough to decide it. -/
141	structure Scenario where
142	  name : String
143	  rule : String
144	  trace : Trace
145	  reading : Reading
146	  manifest : Manifest
147	  grounding : List (String × TrackId)
148	  regions : List (String × RegionId) := []   -- an instance's region formals, each a region of the trace
149	  expected : Verdict
150	  window : Option (Timestamp × Timestamp) := none
151	  boundary : String := ""
152	  deriving Repr, Inhabited
153	
154	namespace Scenario
155	/-- The operators that look back from the observation they judge, by the tag their truncation at the
156	    start of a trace carries: only these leave a history-boundary witness unknown. -/
157	def pastOps : List String :=
158	  ["since", "since_rise", "rises", "once", "holdsFor", "atLast", "count", "distance_while", "prim_heading_change",
159	   "heading_since"]
160	
161	/-- The witness holds when the rule's episode verdict on its grounding has the expected tag, and
162	    the verdict is reached for the reason the witness is about: a `notApplicable` witness needs an
163	    instant at which every bound track is present (a track that never appears leaves any rule not
164	    engaged); an `unknown` witness must be unknown only for atoms its manifest masks (an unbound
165	    variable, a truncated window or a missing parameter is a defect, not a masked observation),
166	    except that a history-boundary witness is unknown for a window truncated at the start of its
167	    trace, at least once, and otherwise only for masked atoms; a boundary is declared on an
168	    `unknown` witness only.
169	    The rules are evaluated with their concept calls expanded over `concepts`. A trace the
170	    admission rejects, or a region formal given a region no scene of the trace holds, fails. -/
171	def run (rules : List Rule) (sc : Scenario) (concepts : List Concept := []) : Except String Verdict := do
172	  let rules := rules.map (Concept.expandRule concepts)

/-
  TrafficSpec.Core.Evidence.Builders
  Scenarios for witnesses and tests: a scene and a trace from a few named quantities, padding by
  timestamp, masking under a manifest, and the `Scenario` a witness file declares.

  A witness must be indistinguishable from adapter output to an atom, so everything here goes
  through the `World` constructors and nothing else. Reachable from `Witness/**` and `Tests/**`
  only: a rule that could build its own evidence proves nothing.

  No default magnitude lives here — every extent, speed and distance is an argument the witness
  writes through a `Units` constructor.
-/
import TrafficSpec.Core.Runtime.Monitor

namespace TrafficSpec
namespace Build

/-- Cardinal unit headings in the world frame (+x east, +y north). -/
def east : Vec := (Q.ofInt 1, Q.zero)
def west : Vec := (Q.ofInt (-1), Q.zero)
def north : Vec := (Q.zero, Q.ofInt 1)
def south : Vec := (Q.zero, Q.ofInt (-1))

def scale (h : Vec) (k : Q) : Vec := (Q.mul h.1 k, Q.mul h.2 k)

/-- A road user with position, heading and speed; velocity follows the heading, path length
    is the caller's (cumulative) figure, extents are half-length/half-width/half-height. -/
def user (track : TrackId) (classes : List RoadUserClass) (pos : Vec) (heading : Vec) (speed : Q)
    (halfExtent : Q × Q × Q) (pathLength : Option Q := none) : RoadUser :=
  { track := track
    classes := some classes
    kin := { position := some pos
             heading := some heading
             velocity := some (scale heading speed)
             speed := some speed
             extent := some halfExtent
             pathLength := pathLength } }

/-- A road user of which only the position (and classes) was observed. -/
def sparseUser (track : TrackId) (classes : List RoadUserClass) (pos : Vec) : RoadUser :=
  { track := track, classes := some classes, kin := { position := some pos } }

def withSignals (u : RoadUser) (f : Signals → Signals) : RoadUser := { u with sig := f u.sig }
def withKin (u : RoadUser) (f : Kin → Kin) : RoadUser := { u with kin := f u.kin }
/-- A measured relation from `a` to `b`, with the measured fields the source supplies. -/
def relation (a b : TrackId) (f : MeasuredRelation → MeasuredRelation := id) : MeasuredRelation := f { a := a, b := b }
def withRelations (s : Scene) (rs : List MeasuredRelation) : Scene := { s with relations := rs }

/-- A region of a kind with a polygon boundary. -/
def region (id : RegionId) (kind : StructureKind) (boundary : List Vec) : Structure :=
  { id := id, kind := kind, boundary := some boundary }
/-- An axis-aligned rectangular region from two corners. -/
def rect (id : RegionId) (kind : StructureKind) (x0 y0 x1 y1 : Q) : Structure :=
  region id kind [(x0, y0), (x1, y0), (x1, y1), (x0, y1)]
/-- A lane with its direction and neighbours. -/
def lane (id : RegionId) (boundary : List Vec) (direction : Vec)
    (left right : Option RegionId := none) (ordinal count : Option Nat := none)
    (leadsTo : Option (List RegionId) := none) (enters : Option RegionId := none) : Structure :=
  { id := id
    kind := .lane
    boundary := some boundary
    lane := some { direction := some direction, leftNeighbour := left, rightNeighbour := right,
                   ordinalFromLeft := ordinal, countInDirection := count, leadsTo := leadsTo,
                   entersIntersection := enters } }
def point (id : RegionId) (kind : StructureKind) (pos : Vec) : Structure :=
  { id := id, kind := kind, position := some pos }

def device (id : DeviceId) (kind : DeviceKind) (governs : List RegionId) (pos : Option Vec := none) : Device :=
  { id := id, kind := kind, governs := governs, position := pos }
def signal (id : DeviceId) (governs : List RegionId) (shows : List SignalIndication) : Device :=
  { device id .trafficSignal governs with indications := some shows }
def sign (id : DeviceId) (kind : DeviceKind) (governs : List RegionId) : Device := device id kind governs
def speedLimit (id : DeviceId) (governs : List RegionId) (value : Q) (kind : SpeedSignKind) : Device :=
  { device id .speedLimitSign governs with speedValue := some value, speedKind := some kind }
def zoneSign (id : DeviceId) (governs : List RegionId) (kind : ZoneKind) (isEnd : Bool)
    (conditions : Option Conditions := none) : Device :=
  { device id .zoneSign governs with zoneKind := some kind, isEnd := some isEnd, conditions := conditions }

/-- Occupancy from the geometry: every user inside every region whose boundary contains its position. -/
def occupancyFromGeometry (users : List RoadUser) (structures : List Structure) : List (TrackId × RegionId) :=
  users.flatMap fun u =>
    match u.kin.position with
    | none => []
    | some p => structures.filterMap fun st =>
      match st.boundary with
      | some poly => if Geom.inPolygon p poly then some (u.track, st.id) else none
      | none => none

/-- A scene; occupancy is derived from geometry unless given. -/
def scene (t : Timestamp) (subject : Option TrackId) (users : List RoadUser) (structures : List Structure)
    (devices : List Device) (occupies : Option (List (TrackId × RegionId)) := none)
    (env : Env := {}) (assumptions : List (AsmId × Bool) := []) (intents : List DeclaredIntent := []) : Scene :=
  { t := t
    subject := subject
    users := users
    structures := structures
    devices := devices
    occupancyObserved := users.map (·.track)
    occupies := occupies.getD (occupancyFromGeometry users structures)
    env := env
    assumptions := assumptions
    intents := intents }

/-- A trace from a scene generator over instants `t0, t0 + dt, …` (`dt` in seconds). -/
def trace (n : Nat) (t0 : Timestamp) (dt : Q) (f : Nat → Timestamp → Scene) : Trace :=
  (List.range n).map fun k =>
    let t : Timestamp := t0 + (Q.mul (Q.ofInt (Int.ofNat k)) (Q.mul dt (Q.ofInt 1000))).num /
      (Q.mul dt (Q.ofInt 1000)).den
    f k t

/-- Repeat the first and last scenes for `before`/`after` seconds at spacing `dt`, so that windows
    at the ends of the interesting part are covered rather than truncated. -/
def pad (τ : Trace) (before after dt : Q) : Trace :=
  match τ.head?, τ.getLast? with
  | some first, some last =>
    let step : Timestamp := (Q.mul dt (Q.ofInt 1000)).num / (Q.mul dt (Q.ofInt 1000)).den
    let nb := ((Q.div before dt).num / (Q.div before dt).den).toNat
    let na := ((Q.div after dt).num / (Q.div after dt).den).toNat
    let pre := (List.range nb).reverse.map fun k => { first with t := first.t - step * (k + 1) }
    let post := (List.range na).map fun k => { last with t := last.t + step * (k + 1) }
    pre ++ τ ++ post
  | _, _ => τ

def masked (m : Manifest) (τ : Trace) : Trace := maskTrace m τ

/-- A manifest that observes every atom except the listed ids (for a `blind` witness). -/
def manifest (absent : List String := []) (gap : Q := Q.zero) : Manifest :=
  let full := Manifest.full "witness" gap
  { full with entries := full.entries.map fun (id, c) => if absent.contains id then (id, .absent) else (id, c) }

end Build

/-- A witness: a rule, a trace, the reading and manifest it assumes, the grounding it speaks
    about (binder ↦ track) and the episode verdict the plan declared over `window` (a closed range
    of timestamps; the whole trace when absent). A lookback window is truncated at the start of
    every finite trace, so a witness about a rule with one names the instants it speaks about.
    A witness is a test of the rule, not evidence about the law: it shows the formulas reach the
    verdict it names, on a scene its author built. A history-boundary witness (`boundary` names the
    history its trace lacks) shows that the rule stays unknown where the trace does not reach back
    far enough to decide it. -/
structure Scenario where
  name : String
  rule : String
  trace : Trace
  reading : Reading
  manifest : Manifest
  grounding : List (String × TrackId)
  regions : List (String × RegionId) := []   -- an instance's region formals, each a region of the trace
  expected : Verdict
  window : Option (Timestamp × Timestamp) := none
  boundary : String := ""
  deriving Repr, Inhabited

namespace Scenario
/-- The operators that look back from the observation they judge, by the tag their truncation at the
    start of a trace carries: only these leave a history-boundary witness unknown. -/
def pastOps : List String :=
  ["since", "since_rise", "rises", "once", "holdsFor", "atLast", "count", "distance_while", "prim_heading_change",
   "heading_since"]

/-- The witness holds when the rule's episode verdict on its grounding has the expected tag, and
    the verdict is reached for the reason the witness is about: a `notApplicable` witness needs an
    instant at which every bound track is present (a track that never appears leaves any rule not
    engaged); an `unknown` witness must be unknown only for atoms its manifest masks (an unbound
    variable, a truncated window or a missing parameter is a defect, not a masked observation),
    except that a history-boundary witness is unknown for a window truncated at the start of its
    trace, at least once, and otherwise only for masked atoms; a boundary is declared on an
    `unknown` witness only.
    The rules are evaluated with their concept calls expanded over `concepts`. A trace the
    admission rejects, or a region formal given a region no scene of the trace holds, fails. -/
def run (rules : List Rule) (sc : Scenario) (concepts : List Concept := []) : Except String Verdict := do
  let rules := rules.map (Concept.expandRule concepts)
  let r ← match rules.find? (·.id == sc.rule) with
    | some r => pure r
    | none => throw s!"{sc.name}: rule {sc.rule} is not registered"
  let S ← match Grounding.Setup.admit rules (maskTrace sc.manifest sc.trace) sc.reading sc.manifest.reidGap with
    | .ok S => pure S
    | .error ds => throw s!"{sc.name}: the trace is not admitted: {"; ".intercalate ds}"
  for (n, reg) in sc.regions do
    if !(sc.trace.any fun s => (s.structure? reg).isSome) then
      throw s!"{sc.name}: region formal `{n}` is region {reg}, which is no structure of the trace"
  let g : Grounding.Grounding := ⟨sc.grounding.map (fun (n, t) => (n, Grounding.canon S.cm t)), sc.regions⟩
  let tl := Grounding.evaluate S r g
  let rows := tl.verdicts.toList.filter fun (t, _) =>
    match sc.window with
    | some (a, b) => a ≤ t && t ≤ b
    | none => true
  let got := Grounding.episode (rows.map (·.2))
  if !sc.boundary.isEmpty && sc.expected.tag != "unknown" then
    throw s!"{sc.name}: a history boundary is declared on a witness that expects {sc.expected.tag}, not unknown"
  if got.tag != sc.expected.tag then
    throw s!"{sc.name}: expected {sc.expected.tag}, got {got.tag} {(got.reasons.map UnknownReason.tag)}"
  match sc.expected with
  | .notApplicable =>
    if tl.present then pure got
    else throw s!"{sc.name}: not applicable, but no instant has every bound track present"
  | .unknown _ =>
    let absent := sc.manifest.absentIds
    let truncated := fun (w : UnknownReason) => match w with | .windowTruncated op => pastOps.contains op | _ => false
    let stray := got.reasons.filter fun w => match w with
      | .absentAtom n => !(atomIdOf n).any absent.contains
      | w => sc.boundary.isEmpty || !truncated w
    if !stray.isEmpty then
      throw s!"{sc.name}: unknown for {(stray.map UnknownReason.tag)}, not for an atom the manifest masks{if sc.boundary.isEmpty then "" else " or a window truncated at the trace start"}"
    else if !sc.boundary.isEmpty && !got.reasons.any truncated then
      throw s!"{sc.name}: a history-boundary witness, but no window is truncated at the trace start"
    else pure got
  | _ => pure got
end Scenario

end TrafficSpec

1	/-
2	  TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Temporal
3	  The temporal operators over a whole trace at once: every operator maps per-instant arrays to a
4	  per-instant array in one pass (or one pass plus O(1) window queries), so a formula costs
5	  O(|φ| · n log n) per grounding. Semantics and Derived both use these; nothing here knows what
6	  a formula or a road user is.
7	
8	  Finite-trace policy: the unobserved past and future are unknown (`windowTruncated`), never a
9	  verdict. A lookback window must be covered and adequately sampled; a lookahead window is true
10	  on a witness, false only when covered.
11	-/
12	import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Time
13	import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Unknown
14	
15	namespace TrafficSpec
16	namespace Temporal
17	
18	def const (n : Nat) (r : R) : Array R := Array.replicate n r
19	def truncated (op : String) : R := R.u (.windowTruncated op)
20	
21	-- pointwise connectives
22	def zipAnd (a b : Array R) : Array R := Array.zipWith R.and a b
23	def zipOr (a b : Array R) : Array R := Array.zipWith R.or a b
24	def zipImplies (a b : Array R) : Array R := Array.zipWith R.implies a b
25	def mapNot (a : Array R) : Array R := a.map R.not
26	def allOf (n : Nat) (xs : List (Array R)) : Array R := xs.foldl zipAnd (const n R.t)
27	def anyOf (n : Nat) (xs : List (Array R)) : Array R := xs.foldl zipOr (const n R.f)
28	
29	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
30	-- Unbounded operators: one backward or forward pass with the unobserved tail as unknown.
31	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
32	private def backward (tail : R) (step : R → R → R) (vals : Array R) : Array R :=
33	  let n := vals.size
34	  ((List.range n).reverse.foldl (fun (acc : Array R × R) i =>
35	    let r := step vals[i]! acc.2
36	    (acc.1.set! i r, r)) (Array.replicate n tail, tail)).1
37	
38	private def forward (head : R) (step : R → R → R) (vals : Array R) : Array R :=
39	  let n := vals.size
40	  ((List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array R × R) i =>
41	    let r := step vals[i]! acc.2
42	    (acc.1.set! i r, r)) (Array.replicate n head, head)).1
43	
44	/-- `always φ`: φ here and at every later observation, and the unobserved future. -/
45	def alwaysAll (φ : Array R) : Array R := backward (truncated "always") R.and φ
46	/-- `eventually φ`: φ here or later, or the unobserved future. -/
47	def eventuallyAll (φ : Array R) : Array R := backward (truncated "eventually") R.or φ
48	/-- Strong until: `ψ ∨ (φ ∧ until')`, the unobserved future as the tail. -/
49	def untilAll (φ ψ : Array R) : Array R :=
50	  let n := ψ.size
51	  ((List.range n).reverse.foldl (fun (acc : Array R × R) i =>
52	    let r := R.or ψ[i]! (R.and φ[i]! acc.2)
53	    (acc.1.set! i r, r)) (Array.replicate n (truncated "until"), truncated "until")).1
54	/-- Since: `ψ ∨ (φ ∧ since')`, the unobserved past as the head. -/
55	def sinceAll (φ ψ : Array R) : Array R :=
56	  let n := ψ.size
57	  ((List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array R × R) i =>
58	    let r := R.or ψ[i]! (R.and φ[i]! acc.2)
59	    (acc.1.set! i r, r)) (Array.replicate n (truncated "since"), truncated "since")).1
60	/-- `once φ`: φ here or at some earlier observation, or the unobserved past. -/
61	def onceAll (φ : Array R) : Array R := forward (truncated "once") (fun v acc => R.or v acc) φ
62	/-- φ at the previous observation (`first` at the trace start). -/
63	def prevAll (first : R) (φ : Array R) : Array R :=
64	  (Array.range φ.size).map fun i => if i = 0 then first else φ[i - 1]!
65	
66	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
67	-- Metric windows: positions per instant (time or path), a length d, per-instant values.
68	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
69	/-- φ at every observation in the window of length `d` behind each instant. Unknown where a
70	    position inside the window is missing; where the window is not covered, false on a false
71	    already observed inside it and unknown otherwise; unknown where it is covered but not
72	    adequately sampled. -/
73	def holdsForAll (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (missing : UnknownReason) (φ : Array R) : Array R :=
74	  let wins := Time.backWindows pos d
75	  let agg := RangeAgg.build φ
76	  (Array.range φ.size).map fun i =>
77	    match wins[i]! with
78	    | none => R.u missing
79	    | some w =>
80	      if !w.covered then (if (agg.all w.j0 i).v = .f then R.f else truncated op)
81	      else if !w.adequate then R.u (.samplingGap op)
82	      else agg.all w.j0 i
83	
84	/-- The value of φ at the latest observation `j` in `[j0, i]` at which ψ held: unknown where ψ is
85	    unknown at an observation later than any at which it held; none where ψ held nowhere in the range. -/
86	private def atLastAt (ψ φ : Array R) (j0 i : Nat) : Option R :=
87	  (List.range (i + 1 - j0)).foldl (fun (acc : Option R) k =>
88	    match acc with
89	    | some r => some r
90	    | none =>
91	      let j := i - k
92	      match ψ[j]!.v with
93	      | .t => some φ[j]!
94	      | .u => some ⟨.u, ψ[j]!.why⟩
95	      | .f => none) none
96	
97	/-- φ at the last observation in the window of length `d` behind each instant at which ψ held.
98	    Unknown where a position is missing, where ψ is unknown later than any observation at which it
99	    held, where the window is not adequately sampled (an unobserved later instant could be the last
100	    one at which ψ held), and where ψ held nowhere in a window that is not covered; false where ψ
101	    held nowhere in a covered, adequately sampled window. -/
102	def atLastAll (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (missing : UnknownReason) (ψ φ : Array R) : Array R :=
103	  let wins := Time.backWindows pos d
104	  (Array.range φ.size).map fun i =>
105	    match wins[i]! with
106	    | none => R.u missing
107	    | some w =>
108	      match atLastAt ψ φ w.j0 i with
109	      | some r => if !w.adequate then R.u (.samplingGap op) else r
110	      | none => if !w.covered then truncated op else if !w.adequate then R.u (.samplingGap op) else R.f
111	
112	/-- φ at some observation in the window of length `d` ahead: true on a witness, false only when
113	    the window is covered, unknown when it runs off the trace. -/
114	def withinAll (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (missing : UnknownReason) (φ : Array R) : Array R :=
115	  let wins := Time.forwardWindows pos d
116	  let agg := RangeAgg.build φ
117	  (Array.range φ.size).map fun i =>
118	    match wins[i]! with
119	    | none => R.u missing
120	    | some w =>
121	      if !w.adequate then R.u (.samplingGap op)
122	      else
123	        let a := agg.any i w.jl
124	        if w.covered then a else R.or a (truncated op)
125	
126	/-- Smallest `k ≥ i` whose value satisfies `p` (size when none), per instant. -/
127	def nextWhere (vals : Array R) (p : Tri → Bool) : Array Nat :=
128	  let n := vals.size
129	  (List.range n).reverse.foldl (fun (acc : Array Nat) i =>
130	    acc.set! i (if p vals[i]!.v then i else acc[i + 1]!)) (Array.replicate (n + 1) n)
131	
132	/-- Strong until restricted to the window ahead: ∃ j in the window, ψ at j and φ at every
133	    observation from here to just before j; the unobserved remainder counts as unknown unless φ
134	    already failed. -/
135	def untilWithinAll (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (missing : UnknownReason) (φ ψ : Array R) : Array R :=
136	  let wins := Time.forwardWindows pos d
137	  let aggφ := RangeAgg.build φ
138	  let aggψ := RangeAgg.build ψ
139	  let firstψ := nextWhere ψ (· = .t)
140	  let firstφf := nextWhere φ (· = .f)
141	  (Array.range φ.size).map fun i =>
142	    match wins[i]! with
143	    | none => R.u missing
144	    | some w =>
145	      if !w.adequate then R.u (.samplingGap op)
146	      else
147	        let b := firstψ[i]!
148	        -- φ at every observation from i up to, not including, b (empty when b = i)
149	        let φBefore (b : Nat) : R := if b ≤ i then R.t else aggφ.all i (b - 1)
150	        let witnessed : R :=
151	          if b ≤ w.jl && (φBefore b).v = .t then R.t
152	          else
153	            -- false only if every candidate fails: ψ false up to the first φ failure (or the window end)
154	            let a := firstφf[i]!
155	            let hi := min a w.jl
156	            let ψany := aggψ.any i hi
157	            if ψany.v = .f then R.f
158	            else
159	              let why := (if ψany.v = .u then ψany.why else []) ++
160	                (if b ≤ w.jl then (φBefore b).why else [])
161	              ⟨.u, if why.isEmpty then [.windowTruncated op] else why⟩
162	        if w.covered then witnessed
163	        else R.or witnessed (R.and (truncated op) (aggφ.all i w.jl))
164	
165	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
166	-- Runs and counts
167	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
168	/-- The first instant of the latest run of true values ending at the latest true instant ≤ i:
169	    "since φ became true". `none` before any true; an error where an unknown value hides the
170	    run's start, and `windowTruncated op` where the run reaches the trace start (it may have
171	    begun before the recording). -/
172	def runStartAll (op : String) (vals : Array R) : Array (Except UnknownReason (Option Nat)) :=
173	  let n := vals.size
174	  ((List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array (Except UnknownReason (Option Nat)) × Except UnknownReason (Option Nat)) i =>
175	    let v := vals[i]!
176	    let st : Except UnknownReason (Option Nat) :=
177	      match v.v with
178	      | .t =>
179	        if i = 0 then .error (.windowTruncated op)
180	        else match vals[i - 1]!.v with
181	          | .t => acc.2
182	          | .f => .ok (some i)
183	          | .u => .error (vals[i - 1]!.why.head?.getD (.malformed op))
184	      | .f => acc.2
185	      | .u => .error (v.why.head?.getD (.malformed op))
186	    (acc.1.push st, st)) (Array.mkEmpty n, .ok none)).1
187	
188	/-- Path length over which `holds` has held continuously up to each instant: zero where it does
189	    not hold, unknown where it is unknown, where the path length is missing, or where the run
190	    reaches the trace start. -/
191	def distanceWhileAll (pathPos : Array (Option Q)) (holds : Array R) : Array QR :=
192	  let starts := runStartAll "distance_while" holds
193	  (Array.range holds.size).map fun i =>
194	    match holds[i]!.v with
195	    | .f => .ok Q.zero
196	    | .u => .error (holds[i]!.why.head?.getD (.malformed "distance_while"))
197	    | .t =>
198	      match starts[i]! with
199	      | .error e => .error e
200	      | .ok none => .error (.windowTruncated "distance_while")
201	      | .ok (some j) =>
202	        match pathPos[i]!, pathPos[j]! with
203	        | some pi, some pj => .ok (Q.sub pi pj)
204	        | _, _ => .error (.absentAtom "kin_path_length")
205	
206	/-- Rising edges of `edge` since the start of the latest run of `sinceφ`, per instant. -/
207	def countEdgesAll (op : String) (edge sinceφ : Array R) : Array (Except UnknownReason Nat) :=
208	  let n := edge.size
209	  let starts := runStartAll op sinceφ
210	  -- edge k: true when edge[k] = t and edge[k-1] = f; unknown when either is unknown
211	  let edgeVal : Array (Except UnknownReason Bool) := (Array.range n).map fun k =>
212	    if k = 0 then .ok false
213	    else match edge[k]!.v, edge[k - 1]!.v with
214	      | .u, _ => .error (edge[k]!.why.head?.getD (.malformed "count"))
215	      | _, .u => .error (edge[k - 1]!.why.head?.getD (.malformed "count"))
216	      | .t, .f => .ok true
217	      | _, _ => .ok false
218	  let prefT := (List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array Nat) k =>
219	    acc.push (acc[k]! + (match edgeVal[k]! with | .ok true => 1 | _ => 0))) #[0]
220	  let prefU := (List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array Nat) k =>
221	    acc.push (acc[k]! + (match edgeVal[k]! with | .error _ => 1 | _ => 0))) #[0]
222	  let nextU := (List.range n).reverse.foldl (fun (acc : Array Nat) k =>
223	    acc.set! k (match edgeVal[k]! with | .error _ => k | _ => acc[k + 1]!)) (Array.replicate (n + 1) n)
224	  (Array.range n).map fun i =>
225	    match starts[i]! with
226	    | .error e => .error e
227	    | .ok none => .error (.windowTruncated op)
228	    | .ok (some j) =>
229	      -- edges at k ∈ (j, i]
230	      if prefU[i + 1]! - prefU[j + 1]! > 0 then
231	        match edgeVal[nextU[j + 1]!]! with | .error e => .error e | _ => .error (.malformed op)
232	      else .ok (prefT[i + 1]! - prefT[j + 1]!)
233	
234	/-- φ here and not at the previous observation, as a three-valued conjunction: false where φ is
235	    false here, or true at the previous observation; true where φ is true here and false before;
236	    unknown otherwise, with the reasons of the values it could not settle, the unobserved past
237	    before the first observation among them. -/
238	def risesAll (φ : Array R) : Array R :=
239	  (Array.range φ.size).map fun i =>
240	    R.and φ[i]! (R.not (if i = 0 then truncated "rises" else φ[i - 1]!))
241	
242	/-- Seconds since φ last became true: from the start of the latest run of true values; unknown
243	    where that run reaches the trace start or none is observed. -/
244	def sinceRiseAll (times : Array Q) (φ : Array R) : Array QR :=
245	  let starts := runStartAll "since_rise" φ
246	  (Array.range φ.size).map fun i =>
247	    match starts[i]! with
248	    | .error e => .error e
249	    | .ok none => .error (.windowTruncated "since_rise")
250	    | .ok (some j) => .ok (Q.sub times[i]! times[j]!)
251	
252	/-- First instant ≤ i at which `vals` is true; an error if an unknown precedes it. A first true at
253	    index 0 is an upper bound on the true onset, which the caller must treat as such. -/
254	def firstTrueAll (vals : Array R) : Array (Except UnknownReason (Option Nat)) :=
255	  let n := vals.size
256	  ((List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array (Except UnknownReason (Option Nat)) × Except UnknownReason (Option Nat)) i =>
257	    let st : Except UnknownReason (Option Nat) :=
258	      match acc.2 with
259	      | .ok (some j) => .ok (some j)
260	      | .error e => .error e
261	      | .ok none =>
262	        match vals[i]!.v with
263	        | .t => .ok (some i)
264	        | .f => .ok none
265	        | .u => .error (vals[i]!.why.head?.getD (.malformed "first"))
266	    (acc.1.push st, st)) (Array.mkEmpty n, .ok none)).1
267	
268	
269	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
270	-- Lengths: every operator returns one value per observation of the array it walks.
271	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
272	section Lengths
273	
274	/-- A left fold whose step keeps the length of the array it carries keeps the initial length. -/
275	theorem size_foldl_carry {α β : Type} (l : List Nat) (f : Array α × β → Nat → Array α × β)
276	    (hf : ∀ acc i, (f acc i).1.size = acc.1.size) (init : Array α × β) :
277	    (l.foldl f init).1.size = init.1.size := by
278	  induction l generalizing init with
279	  | nil => rfl
280	  | cons x xs ih => simp only [List.foldl]; rw [ih, hf]
281	
282	theorem size_const (n : Nat) (r : R) : (const n r).size = n := by simp [const]
283	theorem size_zipAnd (a b : Array R) : (zipAnd a b).size = min a.size b.size := by simp [zipAnd]
284	theorem size_zipOr (a b : Array R) : (zipOr a b).size = min a.size b.size := by simp [zipOr]
285	theorem size_zipImplies (a b : Array R) : (zipImplies a b).size = min a.size b.size := by simp [zipImplies]
286	theorem size_mapNot (a : Array R) : (mapNot a).size = a.size := by simp [mapNot]
287	
288	private theorem size_backward (tail : R) (step : R → R → R) (vals : Array R) :
289	    (backward tail step vals).size = vals.size := by
290	  unfold backward; rw [size_foldl_carry] <;> simp
291	
292	private theorem size_forward (head : R) (step : R → R → R) (vals : Array R) :
293	    (forward head step vals).size = vals.size := by
294	  unfold forward; rw [size_foldl_carry] <;> simp
295	
296	theorem size_alwaysAll (φ : Array R) : (alwaysAll φ).size = φ.size := size_backward _ _ _
297	theorem size_eventuallyAll (φ : Array R) : (eventuallyAll φ).size = φ.size := size_backward _ _ _
298	theorem size_onceAll (φ : Array R) : (onceAll φ).size = φ.size := size_forward _ _ _
299	theorem size_untilAll (φ ψ : Array R) : (untilAll φ ψ).size = ψ.size := by
300	  unfold untilAll; rw [size_foldl_carry] <;> simp
301	theorem size_sinceAll (φ ψ : Array R) : (sinceAll φ ψ).size = ψ.size := by
302	  unfold sinceAll; rw [size_foldl_carry] <;> simp
303	theorem size_prevAll (first : R) (φ : Array R) : (prevAll first φ).size = φ.size := by simp [prevAll]
304	theorem size_holdsForAll (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (w : UnknownReason) (φ : Array R) :
305	    (holdsForAll pos d op w φ).size = φ.size := by simp [holdsForAll]
306	theorem size_atLastAll (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (w : UnknownReason) (ψ φ : Array R) :
307	    (atLastAll pos d op w ψ φ).size = φ.size := by simp [atLastAll]
308	theorem size_withinAll (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (w : UnknownReason) (φ : Array R) :
309	    (withinAll pos d op w φ).size = φ.size := by simp [withinAll]
310	theorem size_untilWithinAll (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (w : UnknownReason) (φ ψ : Array R) :
311	    (untilWithinAll pos d op w φ ψ).size = φ.size := by simp [untilWithinAll]
312	theorem size_distanceWhileAll (pathPos : Array (Option Q)) (holds : Array R) :
313	    (distanceWhileAll pathPos holds).size = holds.size := by simp [distanceWhileAll]
314	theorem size_countEdgesAll (op : String) (edge sinceφ : Array R) :
315	    (countEdgesAll op edge sinceφ).size = edge.size := by simp [countEdgesAll]
316	theorem size_risesAll (φ : Array R) : (risesAll φ).size = φ.size := by simp [risesAll]
317	theorem size_sinceRiseAll (times : Array Q) (φ : Array R) : (sinceRiseAll times φ).size = φ.size := by
318	  simp [sinceRiseAll]
319	
320	end Lengths
321	
322	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
323	-- A window that reaches past the trace start: false only on an observed false, else unknown.
324	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
325	section HoldsFor
326	
327	theorem holdsForAll_getElem! (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (missing : UnknownReason)
328	    (φ : Array R) (i : Nat) (hi : i < φ.size) :
329	    (holdsForAll pos d op missing φ)[i]! =
330	      match (Time.backWindows pos d)[i]! with
331	      | none => R.u missing
332	      | some w =>
333	        if !w.covered then (if ((RangeAgg.build φ).all w.j0 i).v = .f then R.f else truncated op)
334	        else if !w.adequate then R.u (.samplingGap op)
335	        else (RangeAgg.build φ).all w.j0 i := by
336	  unfold holdsForAll
337	  rw [getElem!_pos _ i (by simpa using hi)]
338	  simp
339	
340	/-- At an instant whose window is not covered, a false observation `j` with `w.j0 ≤ j ≤ i` makes
341	    the result false. -/
342	theorem holdsForAll_uncovered_of_f (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (missing : UnknownReason)
343	    (φ : Array R) (i : Nat) (w : Time.Back) (hi : i < φ.size) (hw : (Time.backWindows pos d)[i]! = some w)
344	    (hc : w.covered = false) (j : Nat) (hj0 : w.j0 ≤ j) (hji : j ≤ i) (hf : φ[j]!.v = .f) :
345	    (holdsForAll pos d op missing φ)[i]! = R.f := by
346	  rw [holdsForAll_getElem! pos d op missing φ i hi, hw]
347	  simp [hc, RangeAgg.all_f_of_witness φ w.j0 i j hi hj0 hji hf, R.f]
348	
349	/-- At an instant whose window is not covered and holds no false observation in `[w.j0, i]`, the
350	    result is the truncation, with its reason. -/
351	theorem holdsForAll_uncovered_of_no_f (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (missing : UnknownReason)
352	    (φ : Array R) (i : Nat) (w : Time.Back) (hi : i < φ.size) (hw : (Time.backWindows pos d)[i]! = some w)
353	    (hc : w.covered = false) (hn : ∀ j, w.j0 ≤ j → j ≤ i → φ[j]!.v ≠ .f) :
354	    (holdsForAll pos d op missing φ)[i]! = truncated op := by
355	  rw [holdsForAll_getElem! pos d op missing φ i hi, hw]
356	  have : ((RangeAgg.build φ).all w.j0 i).v ≠ .f := fun hf =>
357	    let ⟨j, h1, h2, _, h3⟩ := RangeAgg.all_f_witness φ w.j0 i hf
358	    hn j h1 h2 h3
359	  simp [hc, this]
360	
361	/-- A false at an instant whose window is not covered has a false observation inside the window. -/
362	theorem holdsForAll_uncovered_f (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (missing : UnknownReason)
363	    (φ : Array R) (i : Nat) (w : Time.Back) (hi : i < φ.size) (hw : (Time.backWindows pos d)[i]! = some w)
364	    (hc : w.covered = false) (hf : (holdsForAll pos d op missing φ)[i]!.v = .f) :
365	    ∃ j, w.j0 ≤ j ∧ j ≤ i ∧ j < φ.size ∧ φ[j]!.v = .f := by
366	  rw [holdsForAll_getElem! pos d op missing φ i hi, hw] at hf
367	  simp only [hc, Bool.not_false, if_true] at hf
368	  split at hf
369	  · obtain ⟨j, h1, h2, _, h3⟩ := RangeAgg.all_f_witness φ w.j0 i ‹_›
370	    exact ⟨j, h1, h2, by omega, h3⟩
371	  · simp [truncated, R.u] at hf
372	
373	end HoldsFor
374	
375	end Temporal
376	end TrafficSpec
