/-
  TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Temporal
  The temporal operators over a whole trace at once: every operator maps per-instant arrays to a
  per-instant array in one pass (or one pass plus O(1) window queries), so a formula costs
  O(|φ| · n log n) per grounding. Semantics and Derived both use these; nothing here knows what
  a formula or a road user is.

  Finite-trace policy: the unobserved past and future are unknown (`windowTruncated`), never a
  verdict. A lookback window must be covered and adequately sampled; a lookahead window is true
  on a witness, false only when covered.
-/
import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Time
import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Unknown

namespace TrafficSpec
namespace Temporal

def const (n : Nat) (r : R) : Array R := Array.replicate n r
def truncated (op : String) : R := R.u (.windowTruncated op)

-- pointwise connectives
def zipAnd (a b : Array R) : Array R := Array.zipWith R.and a b
def zipOr (a b : Array R) : Array R := Array.zipWith R.or a b
def zipImplies (a b : Array R) : Array R := Array.zipWith R.implies a b
def mapNot (a : Array R) : Array R := a.map R.not
def allOf (n : Nat) (xs : List (Array R)) : Array R := xs.foldl zipAnd (const n R.t)
def anyOf (n : Nat) (xs : List (Array R)) : Array R := xs.foldl zipOr (const n R.f)

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Unbounded operators: one backward or forward pass with the unobserved tail as unknown.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
private def backward (tail : R) (step : R → R → R) (vals : Array R) : Array R :=
  let n := vals.size
  ((List.range n).reverse.foldl (fun (acc : Array R × R) i =>
    let r := step vals[i]! acc.2
    (acc.1.set! i r, r)) (Array.replicate n tail, tail)).1

private def forward (head : R) (step : R → R → R) (vals : Array R) : Array R :=
  let n := vals.size
  ((List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array R × R) i =>
    let r := step vals[i]! acc.2
    (acc.1.set! i r, r)) (Array.replicate n head, head)).1

/-- `always φ`: φ here and at every later observation, and the unobserved future. -/
def alwaysAll (φ : Array R) : Array R := backward (truncated "always") R.and φ
/-- `eventually φ`: φ here or later, or the unobserved future. -/
def eventuallyAll (φ : Array R) : Array R := backward (truncated "eventually") R.or φ
/-- Strong until: `ψ ∨ (φ ∧ until')`, the unobserved future as the tail. -/
def untilAll (φ ψ : Array R) : Array R :=
  let n := ψ.size
  ((List.range n).reverse.foldl (fun (acc : Array R × R) i =>
    let r := R.or ψ[i]! (R.and φ[i]! acc.2)
    (acc.1.set! i r, r)) (Array.replicate n (truncated "until"), truncated "until")).1
/-- Since: `ψ ∨ (φ ∧ since')`, the unobserved past as the head. -/
def sinceAll (φ ψ : Array R) : Array R :=
  let n := ψ.size
  ((List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array R × R) i =>
    let r := R.or ψ[i]! (R.and φ[i]! acc.2)
    (acc.1.set! i r, r)) (Array.replicate n (truncated "since"), truncated "since")).1
/-- `once φ`: φ here or at some earlier observation, or the unobserved past. -/
def onceAll (φ : Array R) : Array R := forward (truncated "once") (fun v acc => R.or v acc) φ
/-- φ at the previous observation (`first` at the trace start). -/
def prevAll (first : R) (φ : Array R) : Array R :=
  (Array.range φ.size).map fun i => if i = 0 then first else φ[i - 1]!

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Metric windows: positions per instant (time or path), a length d, per-instant values.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/-- φ at every observation in the window of length `d` behind each instant. Unknown where a
    position inside the window is missing; where the window is not covered, false on a false
    already observed inside it and unknown otherwise; unknown where it is covered but not
    adequately sampled. -/
def holdsForAll (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (missing : UnknownReason) (φ : Array R) : Array R :=
  let wins := Time.backWindows pos d
  let agg := RangeAgg.build φ
  (Array.range φ.size).map fun i =>
    match wins[i]! with
    | none => R.u missing
    | some w =>
      if !w.covered then (if (agg.all w.j0 i).v = .f then R.f else truncated op)
      else if !w.adequate then R.u (.samplingGap op)
      else agg.all w.j0 i

/-- The value of φ at the latest observation `j` in `[j0, i]` at which ψ held: unknown where ψ is
    unknown at an observation later than any at which it held; none where ψ held nowhere in the range. -/
private def atLastAt (ψ φ : Array R) (j0 i : Nat) : Option R :=
  (List.range (i + 1 - j0)).foldl (fun (acc : Option R) k =>
    match acc with
    | some r => some r
    | none =>
      let j := i - k
      match ψ[j]!.v with
      | .t => some φ[j]!
      | .u => some ⟨.u, ψ[j]!.why⟩
      | .f => none) none

/-- φ at the last observation in the window of length `d` behind each instant at which ψ held.
    Unknown where a position is missing, where ψ is unknown later than any observation at which it
    held, where the window is not adequately sampled (an unobserved later instant could be the last
    one at which ψ held), and where ψ held nowhere in a window that is not covered; false where ψ
    held nowhere in a covered, adequately sampled window. -/
def atLastAll (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (missing : UnknownReason) (ψ φ : Array R) : Array R :=
  let wins := Time.backWindows pos d
  (Array.range φ.size).map fun i =>
    match wins[i]! with
    | none => R.u missing
    | some w =>
      match atLastAt ψ φ w.j0 i with
      | some r => if !w.adequate then R.u (.samplingGap op) else r
      | none => if !w.covered then truncated op else if !w.adequate then R.u (.samplingGap op) else R.f

/-- φ at some observation in the window of length `d` ahead: true on a witness, false only when
    the window is covered, unknown when it runs off the trace. -/
def withinAll (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (missing : UnknownReason) (φ : Array R) : Array R :=
  let wins := Time.forwardWindows pos d
  let agg := RangeAgg.build φ
  (Array.range φ.size).map fun i =>
    match wins[i]! with
    | none => R.u missing
    | some w =>
      if !w.adequate then R.u (.samplingGap op)
      else
        let a := agg.any i w.jl
        if w.covered then a else R.or a (truncated op)

/-- Smallest `k ≥ i` whose value satisfies `p` (size when none), per instant. -/
def nextWhere (vals : Array R) (p : Tri → Bool) : Array Nat :=
  let n := vals.size
  (List.range n).reverse.foldl (fun (acc : Array Nat) i =>
    acc.set! i (if p vals[i]!.v then i else acc[i + 1]!)) (Array.replicate (n + 1) n)

/-- Strong until restricted to the window ahead: ∃ j in the window, ψ at j and φ at every
    observation from here to just before j; the unobserved remainder counts as unknown unless φ
    already failed. -/
def untilWithinAll (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (missing : UnknownReason) (φ ψ : Array R) : Array R :=
  let wins := Time.forwardWindows pos d
  let aggφ := RangeAgg.build φ
  let aggψ := RangeAgg.build ψ
  let firstψ := nextWhere ψ (· = .t)
  let firstφf := nextWhere φ (· = .f)
  (Array.range φ.size).map fun i =>
    match wins[i]! with
    | none => R.u missing
    | some w =>
      if !w.adequate then R.u (.samplingGap op)
      else
        let b := firstψ[i]!
        -- φ at every observation from i up to, not including, b (empty when b = i)
        let φBefore (b : Nat) : R := if b ≤ i then R.t else aggφ.all i (b - 1)
        let witnessed : R :=
          if b ≤ w.jl && (φBefore b).v = .t then R.t
          else
            -- false only if every candidate fails: ψ false up to the first φ failure (or the window end)
            let a := firstφf[i]!
            let hi := min a w.jl
            let ψany := aggψ.any i hi
            if ψany.v = .f then R.f
            else
              let why := (if ψany.v = .u then ψany.why else []) ++
                (if b ≤ w.jl then (φBefore b).why else [])
              ⟨.u, if why.isEmpty then [.windowTruncated op] else why⟩
        if w.covered then witnessed
        else R.or witnessed (R.and (truncated op) (aggφ.all i w.jl))

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Runs and counts
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/-- The first instant of the latest run of true values ending at the latest true instant ≤ i:
    "since φ became true". `none` before any true; an error where an unknown value hides the
    run's start, and `windowTruncated op` where the run reaches the trace start (it may have
    begun before the recording). -/
def runStartAll (op : String) (vals : Array R) : Array (Except UnknownReason (Option Nat)) :=
  let n := vals.size
  ((List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array (Except UnknownReason (Option Nat)) × Except UnknownReason (Option Nat)) i =>
    let v := vals[i]!
    let st : Except UnknownReason (Option Nat) :=
      match v.v with
      | .t =>
        if i = 0 then .error (.windowTruncated op)
        else match vals[i - 1]!.v with
          | .t => acc.2
          | .f => .ok (some i)
          | .u => .error (vals[i - 1]!.why.head?.getD (.malformed op))
      | .f => acc.2
      | .u => .error (v.why.head?.getD (.malformed op))
    (acc.1.push st, st)) (Array.mkEmpty n, .ok none)).1

/-- Path length over which `holds` has held continuously up to each instant: zero where it does
    not hold, unknown where it is unknown, where the path length is missing, or where the run
    reaches the trace start. -/
def distanceWhileAll (pathPos : Array (Option Q)) (holds : Array R) : Array QR :=
  let starts := runStartAll "distance_while" holds
  (Array.range holds.size).map fun i =>
    match holds[i]!.v with
    | .f => .ok Q.zero
    | .u => .error (holds[i]!.why.head?.getD (.malformed "distance_while"))
    | .t =>
      match starts[i]! with
      | .error e => .error e
      | .ok none => .error (.windowTruncated "distance_while")
      | .ok (some j) =>
        match pathPos[i]!, pathPos[j]! with
        | some pi, some pj => .ok (Q.sub pi pj)
        | _, _ => .error (.absentAtom "kin_path_length")

/-- Rising edges of `edge` since the start of the latest run of `sinceφ`, per instant. -/
def countEdgesAll (op : String) (edge sinceφ : Array R) : Array (Except UnknownReason Nat) :=
  let n := edge.size
  let starts := runStartAll op sinceφ
  -- edge k: true when edge[k] = t and edge[k-1] = f; unknown when either is unknown
  let edgeVal : Array (Except UnknownReason Bool) := (Array.range n).map fun k =>
    if k = 0 then .ok false
    else match edge[k]!.v, edge[k - 1]!.v with
      | .u, _ => .error (edge[k]!.why.head?.getD (.malformed "count"))
      | _, .u => .error (edge[k - 1]!.why.head?.getD (.malformed "count"))
      | .t, .f => .ok true
      | _, _ => .ok false
  let prefT := (List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array Nat) k =>
    acc.push (acc[k]! + (match edgeVal[k]! with | .ok true => 1 | _ => 0))) #[0]
  let prefU := (List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array Nat) k =>
    acc.push (acc[k]! + (match edgeVal[k]! with | .error _ => 1 | _ => 0))) #[0]
  let nextU := (List.range n).reverse.foldl (fun (acc : Array Nat) k =>
    acc.set! k (match edgeVal[k]! with | .error _ => k | _ => acc[k + 1]!)) (Array.replicate (n + 1) n)
  (Array.range n).map fun i =>
    match starts[i]! with
    | .error e => .error e
    | .ok none => .error (.windowTruncated op)
    | .ok (some j) =>
      -- edges at k ∈ (j, i]
      if prefU[i + 1]! - prefU[j + 1]! > 0 then
        match edgeVal[nextU[j + 1]!]! with | .error e => .error e | _ => .error (.malformed op)
      else .ok (prefT[i + 1]! - prefT[j + 1]!)

/-- φ here and not at the previous observation, as a three-valued conjunction: false where φ is
    false here, or true at the previous observation; true where φ is true here and false before;
    unknown otherwise, with the reasons of the values it could not settle, the unobserved past
    before the first observation among them. -/
def risesAll (φ : Array R) : Array R :=
  (Array.range φ.size).map fun i =>
    R.and φ[i]! (R.not (if i = 0 then truncated "rises" else φ[i - 1]!))

/-- Seconds since φ last became true: from the start of the latest run of true values; unknown
    where that run reaches the trace start or none is observed. -/
def sinceRiseAll (times : Array Q) (φ : Array R) : Array QR :=
  let starts := runStartAll "since_rise" φ
  (Array.range φ.size).map fun i =>
    match starts[i]! with
    | .error e => .error e
    | .ok none => .error (.windowTruncated "since_rise")
    | .ok (some j) => .ok (Q.sub times[i]! times[j]!)

/-- First instant ≤ i at which `vals` is true; an error if an unknown precedes it. A first true at
    index 0 is an upper bound on the true onset, which the caller must treat as such. -/
def firstTrueAll (vals : Array R) : Array (Except UnknownReason (Option Nat)) :=
  let n := vals.size
  ((List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array (Except UnknownReason (Option Nat)) × Except UnknownReason (Option Nat)) i =>
    let st : Except UnknownReason (Option Nat) :=
      match acc.2 with
      | .ok (some j) => .ok (some j)
      | .error e => .error e
      | .ok none =>
        match vals[i]!.v with
        | .t => .ok (some i)
        | .f => .ok none
        | .u => .error (vals[i]!.why.head?.getD (.malformed "first"))
    (acc.1.push st, st)) (Array.mkEmpty n, .ok none)).1


-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Lengths: every operator returns one value per observation of the array it walks.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
section Lengths

/-- A left fold whose step keeps the length of the array it carries keeps the initial length. -/
theorem size_foldl_carry {α β : Type} (l : List Nat) (f : Array α × β → Nat → Array α × β)
    (hf : ∀ acc i, (f acc i).1.size = acc.1.size) (init : Array α × β) :
    (l.foldl f init).1.size = init.1.size := by
  induction l generalizing init with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs ih => simp only [List.foldl]; rw [ih, hf]

theorem size_const (n : Nat) (r : R) : (const n r).size = n := by simp [const]
theorem size_zipAnd (a b : Array R) : (zipAnd a b).size = min a.size b.size := by simp [zipAnd]
theorem size_zipOr (a b : Array R) : (zipOr a b).size = min a.size b.size := by simp [zipOr]
theorem size_zipImplies (a b : Array R) : (zipImplies a b).size = min a.size b.size := by simp [zipImplies]
theorem size_mapNot (a : Array R) : (mapNot a).size = a.size := by simp [mapNot]

private theorem size_backward (tail : R) (step : R → R → R) (vals : Array R) :
    (backward tail step vals).size = vals.size := by
  unfold backward; rw [size_foldl_carry] <;> simp

private theorem size_forward (head : R) (step : R → R → R) (vals : Array R) :
    (forward head step vals).size = vals.size := by
  unfold forward; rw [size_foldl_carry] <;> simp

theorem size_alwaysAll (φ : Array R) : (alwaysAll φ).size = φ.size := size_backward _ _ _
theorem size_eventuallyAll (φ : Array R) : (eventuallyAll φ).size = φ.size := size_backward _ _ _
theorem size_onceAll (φ : Array R) : (onceAll φ).size = φ.size := size_forward _ _ _
theorem size_untilAll (φ ψ : Array R) : (untilAll φ ψ).size = ψ.size := by
  unfold untilAll; rw [size_foldl_carry] <;> simp
theorem size_sinceAll (φ ψ : Array R) : (sinceAll φ ψ).size = ψ.size := by
  unfold sinceAll; rw [size_foldl_carry] <;> simp
theorem size_prevAll (first : R) (φ : Array R) : (prevAll first φ).size = φ.size := by simp [prevAll]
theorem size_holdsForAll (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (w : UnknownReason) (φ : Array R) :
    (holdsForAll pos d op w φ).size = φ.size := by simp [holdsForAll]
theorem size_atLastAll (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (w : UnknownReason) (ψ φ : Array R) :
    (atLastAll pos d op w ψ φ).size = φ.size := by simp [atLastAll]
theorem size_withinAll (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (w : UnknownReason) (φ : Array R) :
    (withinAll pos d op w φ).size = φ.size := by simp [withinAll]
theorem size_untilWithinAll (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (w : UnknownReason) (φ ψ : Array R) :
    (untilWithinAll pos d op w φ ψ).size = φ.size := by simp [untilWithinAll]
theorem size_distanceWhileAll (pathPos : Array (Option Q)) (holds : Array R) :
    (distanceWhileAll pathPos holds).size = holds.size := by simp [distanceWhileAll]
theorem size_countEdgesAll (op : String) (edge sinceφ : Array R) :
    (countEdgesAll op edge sinceφ).size = edge.size := by simp [countEdgesAll]
theorem size_risesAll (φ : Array R) : (risesAll φ).size = φ.size := by simp [risesAll]
theorem size_sinceRiseAll (times : Array Q) (φ : Array R) : (sinceRiseAll times φ).size = φ.size := by
  simp [sinceRiseAll]

end Lengths

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- A window that reaches past the trace start: false only on an observed false, else unknown.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
section HoldsFor

theorem holdsForAll_getElem! (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (missing : UnknownReason)
    (φ : Array R) (i : Nat) (hi : i < φ.size) :
    (holdsForAll pos d op missing φ)[i]! =
      match (Time.backWindows pos d)[i]! with
      | none => R.u missing
      | some w =>
        if !w.covered then (if ((RangeAgg.build φ).all w.j0 i).v = .f then R.f else truncated op)
        else if !w.adequate then R.u (.samplingGap op)
        else (RangeAgg.build φ).all w.j0 i := by
  unfold holdsForAll
  rw [getElem!_pos _ i (by simpa using hi)]
  simp

/-- At an instant whose window is not covered, a false observation `j` with `w.j0 ≤ j ≤ i` makes
    the result false. -/
theorem holdsForAll_uncovered_of_f (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (missing : UnknownReason)
    (φ : Array R) (i : Nat) (w : Time.Back) (hi : i < φ.size) (hw : (Time.backWindows pos d)[i]! = some w)
    (hc : w.covered = false) (j : Nat) (hj0 : w.j0 ≤ j) (hji : j ≤ i) (hf : φ[j]!.v = .f) :
    (holdsForAll pos d op missing φ)[i]! = R.f := by
  rw [holdsForAll_getElem! pos d op missing φ i hi, hw]
  simp [hc, RangeAgg.all_f_of_witness φ w.j0 i j hi hj0 hji hf, R.f]

/-- At an instant whose window is not covered and holds no false observation in `[w.j0, i]`, the
    result is the truncation, with its reason. -/
theorem holdsForAll_uncovered_of_no_f (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (missing : UnknownReason)
    (φ : Array R) (i : Nat) (w : Time.Back) (hi : i < φ.size) (hw : (Time.backWindows pos d)[i]! = some w)
    (hc : w.covered = false) (hn : ∀ j, w.j0 ≤ j → j ≤ i → φ[j]!.v ≠ .f) :
    (holdsForAll pos d op missing φ)[i]! = truncated op := by
  rw [holdsForAll_getElem! pos d op missing φ i hi, hw]
  have : ((RangeAgg.build φ).all w.j0 i).v ≠ .f := fun hf =>
    let ⟨j, h1, h2, _, h3⟩ := RangeAgg.all_f_witness φ w.j0 i hf
    hn j h1 h2 h3
  simp [hc, this]

/-- A false at an instant whose window is not covered has a false observation inside the window. -/
theorem holdsForAll_uncovered_f (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (missing : UnknownReason)
    (φ : Array R) (i : Nat) (w : Time.Back) (hi : i < φ.size) (hw : (Time.backWindows pos d)[i]! = some w)
    (hc : w.covered = false) (hf : (holdsForAll pos d op missing φ)[i]!.v = .f) :
    ∃ j, w.j0 ≤ j ∧ j ≤ i ∧ j < φ.size ∧ φ[j]!.v = .f := by
  rw [holdsForAll_getElem! pos d op missing φ i hi, hw] at hf
  simp only [hc, Bool.not_false, if_true] at hf
  split at hf
  · obtain ⟨j, h1, h2, _, h3⟩ := RangeAgg.all_f_witness φ w.j0 i ‹_›
    exact ⟨j, h1, h2, by omega, h3⟩
  · simp [truncated, R.u] at hf

end HoldsFor

end Temporal
end TrafficSpec

/-
  Witnesses for LVMC_11_18_020.

  Geometry (the witness's own figures; none appears in the rule). +x east, +y north.
  - highway 100: x ∈ [-10, 10], y ∈ [-30, 40].
  - lane 1 (northbound, east half): x ∈ [0, 4], y ∈ [-30, 0], enters intersection 3.
  - lane 2 (northbound, west half; branch_3 only): x ∈ [-4, 0], y ∈ [-30, 0], enters intersection 3.
  - crosswalk 4: x ∈ [-8, 8], y ∈ [0, 4], marking the entrance of the lane the subject drives in.
  - intersection 3: x ∈ [-8, 8], y ∈ [4, 20].
  - centre line 5: x ∈ [-0.1, 0.1], y ∈ [-30, 40].
  - one-way roadway 6 (branch_2 only, no centre line): x ∈ [-4, 4], y ∈ [-30, 0].
  - zone sign 10: kind school_crossing, governing the subject's lane.
  - subject 1: a motor vehicle heading north, half-extents 2.25 × 0.9 × 0.75 m; instants 1 s apart:
    at y = -8 (in its lane only), at y = -1 (body across lane and crosswalk), at y = 6 (crosswalk and
    intersection). Occupancy is stated, since a body lies across two regions.
  - person 2: half-extents 0.3 m, in the crosswalk at (3, 2) — 1 m right of the subject's track, the
    centre line 1.9 m to its left — or at (-3, 2) beyond the centre line.
-/
import TrafficSpec.Rules.LVMC_11.LVMC_11_18_020
import TrafficSpec.Core.Evidence.Builders

namespace TrafficSpecWitness.LVMC_11_18_020

open TrafficSpec

def m (n : Int) : Q := Units.metres n
def cm (n : Int) : Q := Units.centimetres n

-- Binders ↦ tracks: subject ↦ 1

def highway : Structure := Build.rect 100 .highway (m (-10)) (m (-30)) (m 10) (m 40)

def laneEast : Structure :=
  { Build.lane 1 [(m 0, m (-30)), (m 4, m (-30)), (m 4, m 0), (m 0, m 0)] Build.north (enters := some 3)
    with ways := some [100] }

def laneWest : Structure :=
  { Build.lane 2 [(m (-4), m (-30)), (m 0, m (-30)), (m 0, m 0), (m (-4), m 0)] Build.north (enters := some 3)
    with ways := some [100] }

def junction : Structure :=
  { Build.rect 3 .intersection (m (-8)) (m 4) (m 8) (m 20) with ways := some [100] }

def crosswalk (carrier : RegionId) : Structure :=
  { Build.rect 4 .crosswalk (m (-8)) (m 0) (m 8) (m 4) with
    ways := some [100], marked := some true, entranceOf := [carrier], entranceObserved := true }

def centreLine : Structure :=
  { Build.rect 5 .centreLine (cm (-10)) (m (-30)) (cm 10) (m 40) with ways := some [100] }

def oneWay : Structure :=
  { Build.rect 6 .oneWayRoadway (m (-4)) (m (-30)) (m 4) (m 0) with ways := some [100] }

def schoolXing (carrier : RegionId) : Device :=
  Build.zoneSign 10 [carrier] .schoolCrossing false (some {})

def car (x y v : Q) : RoadUser :=
  Build.user 1 [.motorVehicle] (x, y) Build.north v (cm 225, cm 90, cm 75)

def person (cls : RoadUserClass) (x y : Q) : RoadUser :=
  Build.user 2 [cls] (x, y) Build.west (Units.metresPerSecond 1) (cm 30, cm 30, cm 90)

/-- One instant: the subject's position (x, y), speed and occupied regions, and the other road user
    with its occupied regions. -/
abbrev Step := Q × Q × Q × List RegionId × Option (RoadUser × List RegionId)

def mkTrace (steps : List Step) (structs : List Structure) (devs : List Device) : Trace :=
  Build.trace steps.length 0 (Units.seconds 1) fun k t =>
    match steps[k]? with
    | none => Build.scene t (some 1) [] structs devs
    | some (x, y, v, occS, other) =>
      let subj := car x y v
      let us : List RoadUser := match other with
        | some (u, _) => [u]
        | none => []
      let occO : List (TrackId × RegionId) := match other with
        | some (u, rs) => rs.map fun r => (u.track, r)
        | none => []
      Build.scene t (some 1) (subj :: us) structs devs
        (occupies := some ((occS.map fun r => ((1 : TrackId), r)) ++ occO))

def std : List Structure := [highway, laneEast, junction, crosswalk 1, centreLine]

/-- The subject drives from its lane (east half) into the crosswalk while `o` stays in it. -/
def drivesIn (o : RoadUser) : List Step :=
  [ (m 2, m (-8), Units.metresPerSecond 5, [100, 1], some (o, [100, 4]))
  , (m 2, m (-1), Units.metresPerSecond 5, [100, 1, 4], some (o, [100, 4]))
  , (m 2, m 6, Units.metresPerSecond 5, [100, 4, 3], some (o, [100, 4])) ]

/-- `forbid` (violated): A school_crossing sign governs the subject's lane; a child walks in the crosswalk on the subject's half of the roadway; the subject drives into the crosswalk. -/
def forbidTrace : Trace :=
  mkTrace (drivesIn (person .pedestrian (m 3) (m 2))) std [schoolXing 1]

/-- `permit` (compliant): Same, but the subject halts short of the crosswalk until the child has left it. -/
def permitTrace : Trace :=
  let child := person .pedestrian (m 3) (m 2)
  let gone := person .pedestrian (m 12) (m 2)
  mkTrace
    [ (m 2, m (-8), Units.metresPerSecond 5, [100, 1], some (child, [100, 4]))
    , (m 2, m (-3), Units.metresPerSecond 0, [100, 1], some (child, [100, 4]))
    , (m 2, m (-3), Units.metresPerSecond 0, [100, 1], some (gone, []))
    , (m 2, m (-1), Units.metresPerSecond 2, [100, 1, 4], some (gone, [])) ]
    std [schoolXing 1]

/-- `idle` (not_applicable): No school_crossing sign governs the subject's lane; a pedestrian is in the crosswalk. -/
def idleTrace : Trace :=
  mkTrace (drivesIn (person .pedestrian (m 3) (m 2))) std
    [Build.zoneSign 10 [1] .school false (some {})]

/-- `blind` (unknown): The sign is present but the source does not observe which carriers it governs; the subject drives into an occupied crosswalk. -/
def blindTrace : Trace :=
  mkTrace (drivesIn (person .pedestrian (m 3) (m 2))) std
    [{ schoolXing 1 with governs := [], governsObserved := false }]

/-- `branch_1` (not_applicable): The pedestrian is in the crosswalk on the far side of the centre line when the subject drives in. -/
def branch_1Trace : Trace :=
  mkTrace (drivesIn (person .pedestrian (m (-3)) (m 2))) std [schoolXing 1]

/-- `branch_2` (violated): the subject's roadway is one-way (no centre line); a pedestrian at the
    crosswalk's far left is on its side, and the subject drives in. -/
def branch_2Trace : Trace :=
  mkTrace
    [ (m 2, m (-8), Units.metresPerSecond 5, [100, 6, 1], some (person .pedestrian (m (-3)) (m 2), [100, 4]))
    , (m 2, m (-1), Units.metresPerSecond 5, [100, 6, 1, 4], some (person .pedestrian (m (-3)) (m 2), [100, 4]))
    , (m 2, m 6, Units.metresPerSecond 5, [100, 4, 3], some (person .pedestrian (m (-3)) (m 2), [100, 4])) ]
    [highway, oneWay, laneEast, junction, crosswalk 1] [schoolXing 1]

/-- `branch_3` (violated): the subject comes in the west half, the centre line on its right (L < 0);
    a pedestrian in the west half of the crosswalk is on its side, and the subject drives in. -/
def branch_3Trace : Trace :=
  let o := person .pedestrian (m (-3)) (m 2)
  mkTrace
    [ (m (-2), m (-8), Units.metresPerSecond 5, [100, 2], some (o, [100, 4]))
    , (m (-2), m (-1), Units.metresPerSecond 5, [100, 2, 4], some (o, [100, 4]))
    , (m (-2), m 6, Units.metresPerSecond 5, [100, 4, 3], some (o, [100, 4])) ]
    [highway, laneWest, junction, crosswalk 2, centreLine] [schoolXing 2]

/-- `branch_4` (violated): a person riding a bicycle across the crosswalk on the subject's side; the subject drives in. -/
def branch_4Trace : Trace :=
  mkTrace (drivesIn (person .bicycle (m 3) (m 2))) std [schoolXing 1]

/-- `branch_5` (violated): a person riding an electric bicycle across the crosswalk on the subject's side; the subject drives in. -/
def branch_5Trace : Trace :=
  mkTrace (drivesIn (person .electricBicycle (m 3) (m 2))) std [schoolXing 1]

/-- `branch_6` (violated): a person riding an electric scooter across the crosswalk on the subject's side; the subject drives in. -/
def branch_6Trace : Trace :=
  mkTrace (drivesIn (person .electricScooter (m 3) (m 2))) std [schoolXing 1]

def witness (name : String) (τ : Trace) (expected : Verdict)
    (absent : List String := []) (boundary : String := "") : Scenario :=
  { name := name
    rule := "LVMC_11_18_020"
    trace := τ
    reading := {}          -- ignored by the gate: the run's reading is substituted
    manifest := Build.manifest absent
    grounding := [("subject", 1)]
    expected := expected
    boundary := boundary }

def scenarios : List Scenario :=
  [ witness "forbid" forbidTrace .violated
  , witness "permit" permitTrace .compliant
  , witness "idle" idleTrace .notApplicable
  , witness "blind" blindTrace (.unknown []) ["dev.governs"]
  , witness "branch_1" branch_1Trace .notApplicable
  , witness "branch_2" branch_2Trace .violated
  , witness "branch_3" branch_3Trace .violated
  , witness "branch_4" branch_4Trace .violated
  , witness "branch_5" branch_5Trace .violated
  , witness "branch_6" branch_6Trace .violated ]

end TrafficSpecWitness.LVMC_11_18_020

/-
  TrafficSpec.Core.Runtime.Admission
  What a trace must satisfy, as written, before any rule is evaluated on it: the declared facts
  (assumptions and intentions) name what their scene holds, each once, by well-formed ids; no
  structure is labelled with an abstract kind or lists one among the kinds its source cannot tell
  (an abstract kind is the union of the kinds refining it, read only by a formula); and the
  accepted re-identification links are one-to-one.

  The checks are exact and read no geometry, so a recorded trace, a JSON case and a Lean witness
  are held to them alike. `Grounding.Setup.admit` calls them; every evaluation builds its setup
  there.
-/
import TrafficSpec.Core.Runtime.Identity
import TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.Assumptions
import TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.Intentions

namespace TrafficSpec
namespace Admission

private def duplicates {α : Type} [BEq α] (xs : List α) : List α :=
  (xs.filter fun x => xs.count x > 1).eraseDups

/-- The defects of one scene's declared facts. -/
def sceneDefects (s : Scene) : List String :=
  let at_ := s!"scene t={s.t}"
  (s.intents.flatMap fun d =>
    let who := s!"{at_}: intent record ({d.vehicle}, {d.target})"
    (if s.tracks.contains d.vehicle then [] else [s!"{who}: vehicle {d.vehicle} is not a road user of the scene"]) ++
    (if (s.structure? d.target).isSome then [] else [s!"{who}: target {d.target} is not a structure of the scene"]) ++
    ((duplicates (d.values.map (·.1))).map fun id => s!"{who}: `{id}` listed more than once") ++
    ((d.values.map (·.1)).eraseDups.filter (!IntId.wellFormed ·) |>.map fun id => s!"{who}: `{id}` is not a well-formed intention id")) ++
  ((duplicates (s.intents.map fun d => (d.vehicle, d.target))).map fun (v, r) => s!"{at_}: more than one intent record for ({v}, {r})") ++
  (s.structures.flatMap fun st =>
    (if st.kind.isAbstract then [s!"{at_}: structure {st.id} is labelled `{st.kind}`, an abstract kind; label it with a kind that refines `{st.kind}`"] else []) ++
    ((st.unobservedKinds.filter (·.isAbstract)).eraseDups.map fun k =>
      s!"{at_}: structure {st.id} lists `{k}` among unobserved_kinds, an abstract kind; list the kinds refining it that the source cannot tell")) ++
  ((duplicates (s.assumptions.map (·.1))).map fun id => s!"{at_}: assumption `{id}` listed more than once") ++
  ((s.assumptions.map (·.1)).eraseDups.filter (!AsmId.wellFormed ·) |>.map fun id => s!"{at_}: `{id}` is not a well-formed assumption id")

/-- Accepted links that give a track two successors or two predecessors. -/
def linkDefects (τ : Array Scene) (gap : Q) : List String :=
  let links := Grounding.acceptedLinks τ gap
  ((duplicates (links.map (·.1))).map fun t =>
    s!"track {t} is continued by more than one accepted link: {links.filter (·.1 == t)}") ++
  ((duplicates (links.map (·.2))).map fun t =>
    s!"track {t} continues more than one accepted link: {links.filter (·.2 == t)}")

/-- Every defect of the trace as written; empty for a trace every evaluation may read. -/
def defects (τ : Trace) (gap : Q) : List String :=
  τ.flatMap sceneDefects ++ linkDefects τ.toArray gap

end Admission
end TrafficSpec

flagged files under the shared `.runtime/tmp/claude-154266/` tree: the Bash tool's own task-output
files (`tasks/<id>.output`, a new one per command run, so the gate's own invocation creates one),

runtime's tmp directory sits inside the tree the scope check watches. I cannot remove those files
(nothing outside my two files and this report is writable), so I stopped running the gate. The
harness re-runs it after the session. If that run uses the same scope check, it will report the same
thing until `.runtime/tmp` is excluded from the check or moved out of the worktree.

   (I meant to read a Core file). Both node files were written by then.
   Runs 3 and 4 wasted budget. That is my error, though no run could have returned a judgement.

`Semantics.lean` (atom dispatch, quantifiers, `rises`), `Temporal.lean` (`risesAll` at the first
observation is false where φ is false), `Atoms.lean` (`rel_bearing` computed from kinematics,
`st_entrance_of`, `dev_governs`, `isKind` for the abstract `travel_region`), `Builders.lean`, and
`Admission.lean`.

- Class: `ru_aggregate subject "DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle"`.

  - `rel_occupies subject c`, `st_lane_enters c j`, `dev_zone_sign_kind d school_crossing`,
    `dev_governs d c` and `st_entrance_of cw c`;

  selection → ¬ rises(`rel_occupies subject cw`). This re-binds the record's whole selection and
  states the duty for each crosswalk so selected.

- The duty is stated for every selected crosswalk (∀ in the obligation, ∃ in the applicability).

content.text:
The rule and its witnesses are written, but the gate never judged them. All four runs I used returned SCOPE_VIOLATION because of files outside the two node files.

**The blocker:** the scope check counts the temporary files my shell tool writes to `.runtime/tmp/claude-154266/` (one per command), and every gate run creates a new one. By the fourth run it was also flagging output files from other sessions running at the same time (LVMC_11_30_050, LVMC_11_43_010_B_o1). I can't delete those files, so the gate can't return anything else until `.runtime/tmp` is excluded from the check or moved out of the worktree. I stopped at 4 of 6 runs, because more runs would only add more stray files. Two of those four runs were my mistakes: a malformed first command (which made the first stray file) and a gate call I made when I meant to read a Core file. Neither could have returned a real verdict anyway.

Without a gate verdict, I checked the files by hand against the Core source (the evaluator, the temporal operators, the atom accessors, the builders and trace admission). Nothing has compiled or been evaluated yet.

**Rule** (`LVMC_11_18_020.lean`):
- **Subject:** a vehicle, by the aggregate `DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle`.
- **Applies when:**
  - the subject is in a carrier (its lane or other travel region) that enters an intersection;
  - a zone sign of kind `school_crossing` governs that carrier;
  - a crosswalk is recorded as marking that carrier's entrance;
  - another road user (pedestrian, bicycle, electric bicycle or electric scooter) is in that crosswalk on the subject's side of the roadway. "Its side" is tested against the centre line using the lateral-offset primitive and the bearing to the person; on a one-way roadway, the whole crosswalk counts.
- **Obligation:** for every crosswalk selected that way, the subject's occupancy of it must not begin at this observation.
- No narrowings are declared.

**Witnesses:** the five planned scenarios, plus five more so every alternative is tested:
- `branch_2`: a one-way roadway;
- `branch_3`: the centre line on the subject's right;
- `branch_4` to `branch_6`: a bicycle, an electric bicycle and an electric scooter in the crosswalk.

**One risk when the gate does run:** I read the "School-Xing" sign through the zone sign's kind attribute (`dev_zone_sign_kind`), as the record's k5 element says. If the gate treats that attribute as a different atom from the claimed `dev.zone_sign`, it will return UNCLAIMED_ATOM, and the node's claim would need to include the kind attribute.

I don't think the node itself is wrong. The run log, choices and infrastructure issue are written up in `task_result.md` in the working directory.
